user.title: GSW Smart Hot Water
user.description:
Submitting installs/updates the bundled blueprints:
• 🔥 GSW: Smart Hot Water ELITE (main automation)
• 🛡️ GSW: Boiler Safety Watchdog (safety)

Then go to Settings → Automations & Scenes → Blueprints and create an automation from each one.
